title: SymbolFeatures1m v1
description: Per (symbol, exchange, window) market features. Streaming: features.symbol_1m.v1 from detector [R3]. Batch: gold.symbol_features_1m from [R4] MUST use the same definitions (cryptoguard_common.features) to avoid training/serving skew. Consumers: serving sink [R5], ML training [R5]. exchange='ALL' rows aggregate all exchanges for the symbol.

taker_buy_ratio.description: Taker-buy base volume / total base volume, 0..1 (unknown sides excluded).

volume_z.description: (volume_usd - baseline_mean) / baseline_std for same symbol/exchange/hour-of-day over baseline_days; null when baseline missing.

is_complete.description: False if a gap/reconnect was detected inside the window, or late events were dropped.
